amendments.text: [On reciprocating-engine installation, if an air filter is used to protect the engine against foreign material particles in the induction air supply-- (a) Each air filter must be capable of withstanding the effects of temperature extremes, rain, fuel, oil, and solvents to which it is expected to be exposed in service and maintenance; and (b) Each air filter shall have a design feature to prevent material separated from the filter media from interfering with proper fuel metering operation.]

[If an air filter is used to protect the engine against foreign material particles in the induction air supply--] (a) Each air filter must be capable of withstanding the effects of temperature extremes, rain, fuel, oil, and solvents to which it is expected to be exposed in service and maintenance; and (b) Each air filter shall have a design feature to prevent material separated from the filter media from interfering with proper fuel metering operation.
